jobs.feedName: Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering and Computer Science
jobs.title: SDET Intern (Summer 2027) at Cvent Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Cvent Inc. Expires: 10/02/2026 Our Culture and ImpactCvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. AI at Cvent: Leading the FutureAre you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. Internships at CventCvent’s paid internship gives students hands-on experience and direct mentorship that supports their professional development and career growth after college graduation. Interns are exposed to the inner workings of an industry-leading software company while taking ownership of projects that contribute to the company’s continued success. Interns may receive an offer for full-time employment after graduation. In This Role You Will:Work on enterprise software solutions, where performance, reliability and scalability are critical design goals necessary to run large-scale events.Serve as subject matter expert for complex automated testing application design and development issues.Participate as an expert in software redesign process assessing software development projects for quality assurance factors affecting functional requirements and design specifications.Create automation testing strategies, leveraging knowledge of industry-standard software development principles.Review testing documentation, develop testing standards, define criteria for testing, analyze test results, and present results to developers.Develop automated, high-quality test code and scripts utilizing industry-leading tools and frameworks, such as JUnit, Mockito, TestNG, Selenium WebDriver, Postman, etc.Integrate test code into the CI/CD pipeline, review and monitor test results, and work with developers to fix and resolve identified issues.Provide input to systems and applications developers on testing automation procedures and requirements, schedules, or potential problems.Perform maintenance and upgrades to existing test environments.Collaborate with product owners, development leads and other stakeholders to understand product specifics and create corresponding test strategies.Coaching and mentoring cross-functional scrum teams in automated testing and CI/CD.Here's what you need:We care more about your attitude and aptitude than the specific tools and technologies you have used in the past. You need to have a strong passion for software quality and must take pride in the software the team is producing. In addition to this, our ideal candidate will meet the following criteria:Students with graduation date of May 2028Bachelors or Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, or related technical degree.GPA of 3.0 or HigherAble to code comfortably in Java, and other modern programming languages.Experience with scrum, Oracle, databases, and integration testingStrong verbal and written communication skills as you will be presenting complex IT concepts and project metrics to both technical and non-technical audiences.PLEASE NOTE: This position cannot offer any sponsorship, or exception to the graduation dates listed.Most importantly, a successful candidate will be passionate about technology. Keeping up with the latest advancements in the industry; spending time creating, building, and exploring technical projects; an inquisitive attitude in regard to the workings of hardware and software; and overall, simply having fun and finding enjoyment in the field.

Knutson Construction is accepting applications for a Project Engineer Intern to join our team. “Together We Make Dreams Real” – that is our purpose as a company and we exist to work in concert with each other, owners, design professionals and subcontractors to make the journey as stress-free as possible. Together, we’ve created a dynamic, fun, inspiring environment where we can be ourselves and grow each day. Knutson is deeply committed to cultivating and upholding diversity throughout our workforce, relationships, and communities. We recognize the utmost importance of continually advancing our comprehension of diversity, equity, and inclusion as transformative forces within our work, industry, and company values. At Knutson, opportunities to shine happen daily. We value what makes you different and empower you to act on your ideas. jobs.description: Employer: Knutson Construction Expires: 10/02/2026 Celebrated as one of Minnesota’s Top Workplaces! We are seeking a highly motivated Safety intern to join our team. As an intern, you will have the chance to learn from industry professionals, collaborate on real-world projects, and develop skills that will kick-start your career. This paid internship is designed to provide you with a well-rounded experience across different areas of our business.“Together We Make Dreams Real” – that is our purpose as a company and we exist to work in concert with each other, owners, design professionals and trade partners to make the journey as stress-free as possible. Together, we’ve created a dynamic, fun, inspiring environment where we can be ourselves and grow each day. Knutson is deeply committed to cultivating and upholding diversity throughout our workforce, relationships, and communities. We recognize the utmost importance of continually advancing our comprehension of diversity, equity, and inclusion as transformative forces within our work, industry, and company values.At Knutson, opportunities to shine happen daily. We value what makes you different and empower you to act on your ideas.As a safety intern, you will take on responsibilities similar to those of a site safety manager, giving you a firsthand look at a career in construction. A mentor will be assigned to guide and support you throughout the internship. Additionally, you will have the chance to engage in company events and community volunteer activities.Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:Building Trust and Influence: Develop strong relationships with field team members to positively impact their safety practices and encourage a culture of safety.Implementing Safety Programs: Assist in the rollout and execution of company-wide safety programs designed to strengthen defenses against workplace hazards and ensure compliance with safety standards.Balancing Field and Administrative Duties: Efficiently manage your time between fieldwork and administrative tasks. This includes conducting safety inspections, tracking training completions, overseeing equipment inspections, and performing trend analysis to maintain accurate safety records.Promoting Innovative Safety Solutions: Advocate for proactive safety measures by seeking and proposing innovative approaches that focus on hazard elimination rather than mere mitigation.Monitoring and Reporting: Track and report key safety indicators on project sites. Respond to trends and data to enhance overall safety performance and address potential issues.Promote Knutson Construction through community involvement and deliver The Knutson Experience.Exhibit behaviors and actions that are aligned with Knutson’s Zero Incident Safety CultureRespond to and complete all other duties, tasks and/or projects as assigned.Required Skills and Abilities:Ability to work in a team environment.Adaptability and willingness to take on new challenges.Knowledge of and proficient in the use of personal computers and related Microsoft software.Proficient verbal and written communication skills.Strong skills in time management, ability to work under pressure and tight timelines, working with multiple demands with strong attention to details.Ability to travel to and within project sites.Benefits:Gain practical experience in the Construction Industry and learn from industry professionals.Opportunity to contribute to impactful projects and make a difference.Develop valuable skills.Networking opportunities within the company and industry.Exposure to a dynamic and innovative work environment.Possibility of future employment or recommendation upon successful completion of the internship.Minimum Education and/or Experience Requirements:• Currently enrolled in an accredited college and pursuing an associate’s or bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety and Health, Construction Management with a Safety Concentration, or related discipline.Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.Schedule:• Monday to FridayKnutson Construction does not discriminate against applicants on the basis of their race, color, national origin, religion, creed, disability, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, or status with regard to public assistance, or membership or activity in a local human rights commission.

jobs.title: (#REF951M) 2027 Structural Engineer Summer Internship - Seniors and MS Students at KPFF Consulting Engineers
jobs.description: Employer: KPFF Consulting Engineers - Los Angeles Structural Expires: 10/02/2026 KPFF is seeking summer interns interested in experiencing the daily life of a Structural Engineer. We provide you with a summer packed with training programs to prepare you to be successful, activities to help you connect with our team, and real-world projects to apply your skills. At KPFF, 2 out of 3 of our interns return as full-time employees or return for another internship in the next year. Who We Are Looking For Students curious about Structural Engineering and wanting to understand the daily life of a Structural Engineer. We enjoy working with interns who are eager to contribute to their teams and who are interested in making connections and getting to know the people they work with. For this role you will need to have completed a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (with an emphasis in Structures or Architectural Engineering, prior to the start of the internship.You are interested in Structural Engineering and would like the opportunity to be exposed to a wide range of projects and conditions. You enjoy working with and learning from others to create work that you are proud of. You take the initiative to solve challenging problems and are a proactive team member.What You Will Be DoingAs a Structural Engineering Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in structural design, working closely with our experienced engineers on real-world projects. You will have the opportunity to apply your academic knowledge, develop your skills, meet other students who are in the same eld, and contribute to meaningful work. You will assist in the preparation of calculations and construction documents on active jobs under the guidance of project leaders. You will have the opportunity to participate in project meetings and site visits. Position OverviewThis is a non-exempt, temporary position. All overtime hours are paid at a time-and-a-half hourly rate. SalaryThe pay rate for this position is $31.50 an hour for interns awarded a bachelor's degree prior to the start of the internship.Monthly Way We Work stipend to assist with remote work and transit expenses. QualificationsMinimum QualificationsYou must possess a completed bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (with an emphasis in Structures or Architectural Engineering) prior to the start of the internship. Transcripts must show completed courses in: Structural AnalysisMechanics of MaterialsConcreteSteel or Wood Design Additional InformationWork Schedule40-hour work schedule, Monday through Friday Interns work Monday-Thursday in our Orange County Irvine office. Interns have the option to work remotely on Fridays from home. Application ProcessIf you are interested in this position, please apply on our careers page. Resumes sent elsewhere will not be considered.Please provide transcripts for all undergraduate and graduate courses as well as a cover letter. In your cover letter (PDF) please respond to the following prompts:Why have you decided to pursue Structural Engineering?Should you be selected, what are your goals & interests for this internship?Physical Demands and Work EnvironmentDuties are performed in a normal office environment while sitting at a desk or computer table.Duties require the ability to actively engage with a computer for several hours per day.May occasionally need to lift items up to 15 lbs.Duties require in-person attendance, Monday through Friday, during our business hours of 8 AM to 5 PM at our office in Orange County Irvine for the training period. Following a satisfactory training period, a hybrid schedule of 4 days per week Monday through Thursday in the office, and Fridays from home may be accommodated.Our EmployeesOur employees are valued and empowered, collaborative and team oriented, innovative in their approach and passionate about their work. They are reliable, trustworthy and open with a high level of integrity. They value diversity, are inclusive and are committed to critically thinking through problems and finding solutions. Our OfficesOur Greater Los Angeles Structural office has two locations at the Bloc in Downtown Los Angeles and at the Irvine Towers in Irvine. A warm and friendly environment, we are dedicated to growing with our employees and allowing people to pursue their passions. KPFF Consulting Engineers participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.KPFF Consulting Engineers is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ethnicity, national origin, religion, marital status, sex/gender (including sexual orientation or gender identity), pregnancy, veteran status, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, or any other protected basis.

jobs.title: US Manufacturing Internship Program - Garland, Texas at The Kraft Heinz Company
jobs.description: Employer: The Kraft Heinz Company Expires: 10/03/2026 Job DescriptionThe Kraft Heinz US Manufacturing Internship Program is designed to grow the future supply chain manufacturing leaders of our company. Over 10 weeks, interns gain hands-on exposure to end-to-end supply chain execution, collaborate across plant teams and business partners, own their growth, and deliver meaningful results that improve how we make and deliver food and beverage at scale. The internship will be project based in nature supporting our manufacturing functions based in a manufacturing facility. Program Location - Garland, TexasThis opportunity is available at the following manufacturing locations:Garland, Texas (This plant supports our Snackables portfolio)Our Interns will be provided with a one-time housing stipend. What’s on the Menu for the Manufacturing Internship Program? The Kraft Heinz Manufacturing Internship Program is a 10-week Manufacturing plant based leadership development program allowing our interns to own manufacturing projects, develop and practice key leadership skills, and support critical work rooted in driving supply chain excellence through a manufacturing intern experience. The 10-week Manufacturing Internship program includes: One week of immersive plant onboarding to learn about our business and prepare important skills for a successful summer projectTraining on the Kraft Heinz Management System (KHMS), the standard of supply chain excellence for Kraft Heinz globallyEight weeks dedicated to a project exploring unlocking creative solutions and exploring new opportunities in your manufacturing facility.One week of final presentations and celebrations with our executive leadership team and intern peersWeekly sessions to deep dive into our values, grow as leaders, and develop impactful skills for early career success. Based on performance, interns will have an opportunity to return to Kraft Heinz in the 2028 Internship or our 18-month Global Manufacturing Trainee Programs. Throughout the program, Interns can also expect regular opportunities to meet with our business leaders, including the VP of North America Supply Chain; mentorship from previous GMTs and Operations leadership team members; participation in critical supply chain engagements; and curated learning experiences to help with grow as leaders and as cultural ambassadors of Kraft Heinz. Our internship will run from June 7th 2027 to August 13th 2027. What Manufacturing Interns Work OnManufacturing Interns will spend their program in one of our US manufacturing facilities, partnering with plant teams to identify opportunities and deliver improvement projects that strengthen how we operate—enhancing ways of working, core processes, and supply chain performance. Interns typically own a defined project scope, collaborate cross-functionally (Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain), and share results through regular updates and an end-of-program presentation. Project work may include:Continuous improvement & standard work: process mapping, SOP updates, line balance, shift handoffs, visual managementSafety & ergonomics: hazard identification, risk reduction actions, safe work practices, ergonomic improvementsQuality & compliance: defect/rework analysis, root-cause problem solving, first-pass quality improvementsLine performance (OEE): downtime and loss analysis, bottleneck identification, changeover optimization, throughput gainsCost, waste & yield: scrap reduction, material yield improvement, loss elimination initiativesMaintenance & reliability: PM optimization, recurring downtime investigation, reliability improvement plansInventory & execution: material flow improvements, cycle count support, schedule adherence, on-time production/shipping performance We Are Looking For Candidates who...Are pursuing a Bachelors degree with anticipated graduation between December 1, 2027 and June 30, 2029Interested in growing your career in manufacturing plantsPassionate about continuous improvementCreative problem solversAmbitious and humble leadersA drive to make an impactSimplifiersResilience in changing environmentsChampions of our culture and our values The Recruitment ProcessInternship program applications are accepted through October, 2nd 2026. Step 1: Application and Games-Based AssessmentStep 2: Virtual Interviews with Business LeadersStep 3: Final Virtual Interview Day with Operations LeadershipNew Hire Rate$28 USD per Hour ($1120 USD Weekly) Our ValuesOur Manufacturing Interns are expected to live out the Kraft Heinz values as cultural champions and future leaders at the organization. At Kraft Heinz- our values are:We are consumer obsessedWe dare to do better every dayWe champion great peopleWe demand diversityWe do the right thingWe own it About UsKraft Heinz is a global food company with a delicious heritage. With iconic and emerging food and beverage brands around the world, we deliver the best taste, fun and quality to every meal table we touch. We’re on a mission to disrupt not only our own business, but the global food industry. A consumer obsession and unexpected partnerships fuel our progress as we drive innovation across every part of our company. Around the world, our people are connected by a culture of ownership, agility and endless curiosity. We also believe in being good humans, who are working to improve our company, communities, and planet. We’re proud of where we’ve been – and even more thrilled about where we’re headed – as we nourish the world and lead the future of food. Why UsWe grow our people to grow our business. We champion great people who bring ambition, curiosity, and high performance to the table as the guardians of our beloved and nostalgic brands. Good isn't good enough. We choose greatness every day by challenging the ordinary and making bold decisions. All while celebrating our wins - and our failures – as we work together to lead the future of food.Challenging the status quo takes talent. We invest in your purpose and potential by developing skills and nurturing strengths that leave a legacy on our business and a lasting impact on your career. Because great people make great companies, and we’re growing something great here at Kraft Heinz. Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants who require an accommodation to participate in the job application or hiring process should contact NATAI@kraftheinz.com. Location(s)Garland Plant Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.

jobs.description: Employer: Rio Tinto Expires: 10/03/2026 Intern – Electrical EngineeringLocation: Salt Lake City, UT, US If you want to drive real change, we have just the place to do it. jobs.title: US Manufacturing Internship Program - Winchester, Virginia at The Kraft Heinz Company
jobs.description: Employer: The Kraft Heinz Company Expires: 10/03/2026 Job DescriptionThe Kraft Heinz US Manufacturing Internship Program is designed to grow the future supply chain manufacturing leaders of our company. Over 10 weeks, interns gain hands-on exposure to end-to-end supply chain execution, collaborate across plant teams and business partners, own their growth, and deliver meaningful results that improve how we make and deliver food and beverage at scale. The internship will be project based in nature supporting our manufacturing functions based in a manufacturing facility. Program Location - Winchester, VirginiaThis opportunity is available at the following manufacturing locations:Winchester, Virginia(This plant supports our Hydration portfolio)Our Interns will be provided with a one-time housing stipend. What’s on the Menu for the Manufacturing Internship Program? The Kraft Heinz Manufacturing Internship Program is a 10-week Manufacturing plant based leadership development program allowing our interns to own manufacturing projects, develop and practice key leadership skills, and support critical work rooted in driving supply chain excellence through a manufacturing intern experience. The 10-week Manufacturing Internship program includes: One week of immersive plant onboarding to learn about our business and prepare important skills for a successful summer projectTraining on the Kraft Heinz Management System (KHMS), the standard of supply chain excellence for Kraft Heinz globallyEight weeks dedicated to a project exploring unlocking creative solutions and exploring new opportunities in your manufacturing facility.One week of final presentations and celebrations with our executive leadership team and intern peersWeekly sessions to deep dive into our values, grow as leaders, and develop impactful skills for early career success. Based on performance, interns will have an opportunity to return to Kraft Heinz in the 2028 Internship or our 18-month Global Manufacturing Trainee Programs. Throughout the program, Interns can also expect regular opportunities to meet with our business leaders, including the VP of North America Supply Chain; mentorship from previous GMTs and Operations leadership team members; participation in critical supply chain engagements; and curated learning experiences to help with grow as leaders and as cultural ambassadors of Kraft Heinz. Our internship will run from June 7th 2027 to August 13th 2027. What Manufacturing Interns Work OnManufacturing Interns will spend their program in one of our US manufacturing facilities, partnering with plant teams to identify opportunities and deliver improvement projects that strengthen how we operate—enhancing ways of working, core processes, and supply chain performance. Interns typically own a defined project scope, collaborate cross-functionally (Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain), and share results through regular updates and an end-of-program presentation. Project work may include:Continuous improvement & standard work: process mapping, SOP updates, line balance, shift handoffs, visual managementSafety & ergonomics: hazard identification, risk reduction actions, safe work practices, ergonomic improvementsQuality & compliance: defect/rework analysis, root-cause problem solving, first-pass quality improvementsLine performance (OEE): downtime and loss analysis, bottleneck identification, changeover optimization, throughput gainsCost, waste & yield: scrap reduction, material yield improvement, loss elimination initiativesMaintenance & reliability: PM optimization, recurring downtime investigation, reliability improvement plansInventory & execution: material flow improvements, cycle count support, schedule adherence, on-time production/shipping performance We Are Looking For Candidates who...Are pursuing a Bachelors degree with anticipated graduation between December 1, 2027 and June 30, 2029Interested in growing your career in manufacturing plantsPassionate about continuous improvementCreative problem solversAmbitious and humble leadersA drive to make an impactSimplifiersResilience in changing environmentsChampions of our culture and our values The Recruitment ProcessInternship program applications are accepted through October, 2nd 2026. Step 1: Application and Games-Based AssessmentStep 2: Virtual Interviews with Business LeadersStep 3: Final Virtual Interview Day with Operations LeadershipNew Hire Rate$28 USD per Hour ($1120 USD Weekly) Our ValuesOur Manufacturing Interns are expected to live out the Kraft Heinz values as cultural champions and future leaders at the organization. At Kraft Heinz- our values are:We are consumer obsessedWe dare to do better every dayWe champion great peopleWe demand diversityWe do the right thingWe own it About UsKraft Heinz is a global food company with a delicious heritage. With iconic and emerging food and beverage brands around the world, we deliver the best taste, fun and quality to every meal table we touch. We’re on a mission to disrupt not only our own business, but the global food industry. A consumer obsession and unexpected partnerships fuel our progress as we drive innovation across every part of our company. Around the world, our people are connected by a culture of ownership, agility and endless curiosity. We also believe in being good humans, who are working to improve our company, communities, and planet. We’re proud of where we’ve been – and even more thrilled about where we’re headed – as we nourish the world and lead the future of food. Why UsWe grow our people to grow our business. We champion great people who bring ambition, curiosity, and high performance to the table as the guardians of our beloved and nostalgic brands. Good isn't good enough. We choose greatness every day by challenging the ordinary and making bold decisions. All while celebrating our wins - and our failures – as we work together to lead the future of food.Challenging the status quo takes talent. We invest in your purpose and potential by developing skills and nurturing strengths that leave a legacy on our business and a lasting impact on your career. Because great people make great companies, and we’re growing something great here at Kraft Heinz. Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants who require an accommodation to participate in the job application or hiring process should contact NATAI@kraftheinz.com. Location(s)Winchester Plant Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.

jobs.description: Employer: Stephenson Technologies Corporation Expires: 10/03/2026 Systems Administrator Intern Position Summary Stephenson Technologies Corporation (STC) is seeking a motivated Systems Administrator Intern to support our Systems Administrator with the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and security of STC's information technology environment. Basic understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems and computer hardware. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications and services. Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and firewalls. Interest in systems administration, cloud computing, cybersecurity, or IT infrastructure. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn new technologies quickly. Good written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to document technical work. Ability to work independently while also collaborating with technical staff and end users. jobs.title: Engineering Co-op Opportuntities (WI) at Greenheck Group
jobs.description: Employer: Greenheck Group Expires: 10/03/2026 We are looking for a highly motivated Engineering student to join our team as an Engineering Co-op in Central Wisconsin from January to August OR May to December. Greenheck Group is a dynamic, multi-branded international commercial HVAC manufacturer. Our equipment is used worldwide in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities, ranging from comfort ventilation to manufacturing processes. Our efficient products improve comfort, safety, and health of lives across the planet. Since 1947, we are deeply committed to helping you “Build Your Future,” through professional growth, challenging projects, and exciting opportunities to explore your career path. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOINGAs an Engineering Co-op you'll be working in one of the following functional areas based on your skills, interests, major, and business need. Test Engineering - You will be responsible for building prototypes, conducting tests, and documenting results. You will play a key role in developing new products, redesigns, and customer-driven requests, with most of your time spent in our testing lab for a truly hands-on experience. Manufacturing Engineering - You will support daily production by creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures, troubleshooting machines, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You’ll also contribute to layout design and process development to enhance efficiency, quality, and safety across our operations. Product Engineering - You will guide our products from initial concept to market launch. This involves designing, testing, and overseeing the production of new and existing products, ensuring they meet market needs and company goals. Working across research, design, and manufacturing, you’ll ensure products deliver real value to customers and align with company goals. Application Engineering - You will support product development by conducting market research, analyzing customer needs, and assisting with product selection software design and testing. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams - including engineering, product management, marketing, manufacturing, sales, and operations - to improve products, develop training and marketing materials, and contribute to product strategy, customer value, and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVEEnrollment in a related bachelor’s degree program (Mechanical, Industrial, Technology, Manufacturing or Applied Engineering etc.) On track to graduate in the next 3 semesters or less Interest in hands-on learning Curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, innovative environment Experience working with basic hand tools Experience with 3D modeling software (a plus) to expand your technical toolkit and design capabilities Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to support customer-focused solutions THE EARLY TALENT EXPERIENCEAs part of our Early Talent Program, you'll have opportunities to:Develop Your Career: Gain meaningful, real-world experience while working full-time (40 hours a week) throughout your 8-month co-op term.Explore Our Business: Participate in Fundamental Fridays to learn about different areas of the business and hear directly from leaders across the company.Collaborate Across the Company: Be an important part of your team while building relationships and collaborating with others across the organization.Build Your Network: Connect with interns and co-ops across the U.S. and build relationships with approximately 90 fellow college students.Grow Through Feedback: Receive meaningful feedback and coaching throughout your experience, including mid-term and final performance reviews.Connect with Leaders: Share your projects and experiences with company leaders and executives at the end of your term.Make a Difference: Give back through company-sponsored volunteer opportunities and make an impact in our communities. COMPENSATION & BENEFITSGreenheck Group takes pride in providing competitive pay. The pay range for this position is $22.00/hour - $28.00/hour, based on position and academic year.In addition to competitive pay, co-ops and interns receive paid time off for company-observed holidays and are eligible for additional financial support, which may include company-provided housing, a housing allowance, or a sign-on bonus, depending on location, assignment, and length of term. SPECIAL NOTATIONThe preceding statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people in this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTSWork is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment, such as a computer and phone. Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The person is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data, and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Occasional mobility required to attend in-person meetings and complete various office tasks. EEO STATEMENTWe are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. ACCOMMODATIONS REQUESTGreenheck Group complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and candidates with disabilities. To request an accommodation for the application or interview process, please email HR@greenheck.com with your name, job title, posting number, and requested accommodation. RECRUITING FRAUD ALERTAt Greenheck Group, your personal information and online safety are our top priorities. Our recruiters will only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://greenheckgroup.com/careers/. We will never request payments, financial account details, or sensitive information such as Social Security numbers. If you’re unsure about the legitimacy of a message, please contact HR@greenheck.com for verification. If you're looking for a place to grow while working with happy, enthusiastic, values-based people, you'll enjoy your career with us!

At Grant Thornton, we believe in making business more personal and building trust into every result – for our clients and you. Here, we go beyond your expectations of a career in professional services by offering a career path with more: more opportunity, more flexibility, and more support. It’s what makes us different, and we think being different makes us better. In the U.S., Grant Thornton delivers professional services through two specialized entities: Grant Thornton LLP, a licensed, certified public accounting (CPA) firm that provides audit and assurance services ― and Grant Thornton Advisors LLC (not a licensed CPA firm), which exclusively provides non-attest offerings, including tax and advisory services. The platform offers a premier Trans-Atlantic advisory and tax practice, as well as independent American and Irish audit practices. With $2.7 billion in revenues and more than 50 offices spanning the U.S., Ireland and other territories, the platform delivers a singular client experience that includes enhanced solutions and capabilities, backed by powerful technologies and a roster of 12,000 quality-driven professionals enjoying exceptional career-growth opportunities and a distinctive cross-border culture. The threat actors have shifted from simple, nuisance based Cyber hacks to criminals, activists, ransom hacks and nation states. Privacy Compliance Program. Cookie and Consent Management. Data Protection. Cloud Security. Identity and Access Management. Cyber Threat Monitoring. Cyber Incident Management. Cyber War Gaming. Ethical Hacking. jobs.description: Employer: City of Urbandale, IA Expires: 10/04/2026 The Urbandale Fire Department (UFD) is now accepting applications for the 2026-2027 Firefighter/EMS Pathway Internship Program.The Pathway Program is designed for individuals who are beginning their careers in the fire and emergency medical services and have not yet obtained all the certifications required to become a Firefighter/EMT or Firefighter/Paramedic. The program provides participants with an opportunity to gain valuable knowledge, skills, and practical experience while working toward completion of their required fire and EMS certifications. This temporary part-time program has two levels: Intern Level – Non-CertifiedFor candidates who do not currently hold an EMS or Firefighter certification but are enrolled in an accredited fire or EMS training program.Cert 1 Level – Certified For candidates who currently hold an EMS or Firefighter certification.Current Starting Pay:Intern – Non-Certified: $18.17/hourCert 1 – Firefighter only: $18.17/hourCert 1 – EMT only: $18.99/hourCert 1 – Paramedic only: $21.77/hourCandidates who are accepted into the program will be required to work shifts while simultaneously working towards obtaining their fire and EMS certifications. Pathway Program participants will be expected to demonstrate continued progress in both on-the-job performance and the completion of required certifications within designated timeframes. Successful completion of the Pathway Program may provide an opportunity to advance into a regular part-time position with the Urbandale Fire Department.The mission of the Urbandale Fire Department is to preserve life, protect property, and promote safety. With three fire stations strategically located across the city, we respond to more than 6,400 calls per year. Through our automatic aid agreements with six neighboring metro departments, participants have the opportunity to train alongside highly experienced professionals in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The UFD is proud to be internationally accredited by the Commission on Fire Accreditation International (CFAI) - a distinction that recognizes our commitment to excellence in fire and emergency services. We are also deeply committed to community engagement and public education, helping to reduce risk and increase safety awareness throughout Urbandale. This recruitment is for the Pathway Internship Program only. Fully certified candidates are ineligible for the Pathway Program. Certified candidates seeking part-time or full-time employment are encouraged to submit an Interest Card. Routine Job Duties/ResponsibilitiesIntern Level – Non-CertifiedRespond to emergency incidents as an observer, including fire, medical, rescue, and man-made or natural disaster incidents. Under supervision, interns may assist with support activities outside of an Immediately Dangerous to Life and Health (IDLH) environment but may not directly participate in patient care.Learn about fire code enforcement by observing fire/life safety facility inspections.With direct supervision, assist with routine truck and equipment maintenance, station maintenance, and routine facility duties.As part of a crew, assist with community education or community risk reduction activities to improve safety for the community and enhance the reputation of the Fire Department. With direct supervision, complete physical fitness exercises. To the level they have completed in fire or EMS training, may participate in fire/EMS training. With direct supervision, various operational duties may be assigned, which may include inventory, minor equipment maintenance, regular equipment inspection and testing.Assists with station duties necessary to maintain and keep department facilities clean.Assures the city and department’s mission, core values, goals, and objectives are fully supported and initiated. Familiarity with department policies and procedures.Performs vehicle/squad checks and completes vehicle and station routine maintenance and inventory.Performs annual equipment testing.Performs annual or semi-annual cleaning and maintenance on apparatus, equipment, and facilities.Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Cert 1 Level – CertifiedTo their level of certification, responds to emergencies (e.g. fire, medical, rescue, man-made/natural disasters, etc.).If certified firefighter, functions as a member of the assigned fire/rescue crew, performing various fire/rescue tasks under the direction of the crew leader or incident command officer.If certified emergency medical provider, delivers emergency medical treatment within the scope of practice and department protocols of current level of EMT or Paramedic certification. Provides accurate medical documentation of all emergency medical treatment provided, including the use of table-based patient care reporting systems. Completes patient care reporting requirements, including patient medical history, incident history, and billing information.Ensures fire code enforcement by participating in fire/life safety facility inspections, including the field use of tablet-based safety inspection documentation.Under direct supervision, performs routine truck and equipment maintenance, station maintenance and routine facility duties, including the use of tablet-based inventory and vehicle maintenance program.As part of a crew, performs various community education or community risk reduction activities to improve safety for the community and enhance the reputation of the department. Provided the opportunity to participate in physical fitness activities. To their level of certification, participates in fire/EMS training. Completes and maintains EMS/fire/rescue knowledge and skills proficiency through department provided training, including individual, on-line, credential-based, and in-service training, as well as annual evaluations of knowledge and skills are required.As part of a crew, may be assigned various operational duties, which may include inventory, minor equipment maintenance, regular equipment inspection, and testing, Completes assigned station duties necessary to maintain and keep department facilities clean.Operates emergency vehicles in accordance with department policies and procedures and all applicable local, state, and federal laws and regulations.Assures the city and department’s mission, core values, goals, and objectives are fully supported and initiated. Familiarity with department policies and procedures.Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.Performs vehicle/squad checks and completes vehicle and station routine maintenance and inventory.Performs annual equipment testing.Performs annual or semi-annual cleaning and maintenance on apparatus, equipment, and facilities.Typical QualificationsIntern Level – Non-CertifiedMust be enrolled in an accredited fire or EMS training program at the time of hire.Must possess a valid driver's license.Must provide documentation demonstrating a passing score (70% or higher) on the IO Solutions National Firefighter Selection Inventory (NSFI) exam received on or after September 4, 2025.Must be able to perform physical functions of the job while wearing personal protective equipment.Ability to work a minimum of 12 hours per week. Cert 1 Level – CertifiedEMS or Firefighter Certification: Must possess one of the following:A valid Iowa EMT or Paramedic certification;A valid National Registry EMT or Paramedic certification;A valid Iowa Firefighter I certification through FSTB; orA valid out-of-state Firefighter I certification through IFSAC or Pro Board.Must possess a valid driver's license.Must provide documentation demonstrating a passing score (70% or higher) on the IO Solutions National Firefighter Selection Inventory (NSFI) exam received on or after September 4, 2025.Must be able to meet all physical standards for the job as specified by the Fire Retirement System.Must be able to perform physical functions of the job while wearing personal protective equipment.Ability to work a minimum of 24 hours per week.Must be able to pass post-offer/pre-employment: professional reference checks, drug screening, physical, motor vehicle report check, and background check.For a complete list of desired knowledge, skills, and abilities, please refer to the job description.Supplemental InformationCandidates will receive notifications via email from www.governmentjobs.com (NEOGOV). Please apply using an active email address that you check often, and consider enabling text alerts. Your responses to the supplemental questions should be complete yet concise. All eight (8) supplemental questions will be scored as part of the selection process. Applications that are incomplete or missing required documentation will not be considered after the September 20, 2026 11:59 PM deadline.
